question: Should H01 hash the whole HDA library, only Contents, or the complete selected-definition section bundle?
answer: Keep three identities: transport, selected-definition bundle and cook receipt. Whole-library and Contents-only hashes each answer a different, insufficient question.
nextGate: Combine H01/H02 in one isolated Houdini trial: extract all target-definition sections and context, compare packed/expanded transport, then mutate one non-Contents section as a negative control.
